title: Sleep doctor visit
what: The sleep doctor finds out why you sleep badly, snore or feel tired in the day. Sometimes a sleep study is ordered.
why: For insomnia, loud snoring, pauses in breathing during sleep, heavy daytime sleepiness, and restless legs at night.
duration: the visit usually takes 30 to 40 minutes; a sleep study is one night, with results in a few days
tell_doctor: What time you go to bed and get up, and how long you sleep
Whether you snore, and whether anyone has noticed pauses in your breathing
Whether you fall asleep suddenly in the day, for example while driving
Which medicines, sleeping pills and alcohol you take

prepare.title: Sleep diary
prepare.text: For 1 to 2 weeks, write down when you sleep and wake up and how you feel in the morning.

prepare.title: People close to you
prepare.text: Ask whoever sleeps near you to describe your snoring. You can record the sound on your phone.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop sleeping pills on your own. Tell the doctor what you take.

bring: A recording of your snoring, if you have one
steps: The doctor asks about your sleep and how you feel in the day
Examines your throat and neck, measures blood pressure and weight
Decides whether a sleep study is needed
If so, explains how it will be done, at home or at the clinic
feel: In a sleep study you have sensors on your body. Sleeping with them is unusual but painless
after: Follow the sleep routine the doctor advised
If you are sleepy in the day, be careful when driving
Follow-up visit after the study or after a course of treatment
red_flags: You fall asleep at the wheel: do not drive and tell your doctor
Night attacks of choking with chest pain: call your local emergency number

faq.a: Snoring alone is not always. It is dangerous if your breathing stops during sleep, and that needs to be checked.

faq.q: Can I take sleeping pills on my own?
faq.a: Better not. The doctor will find the cause of the insomnia and choose the treatment.

reminders.text: Sleep doctor visit tomorrow. Bring your sleep diary and, if you have one, a recording of your snoring.
